title: Reject stale stock counts and serialize inventory adjustment posting
description: Stage3 core inventory closure. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: An authorized stock-count operator must use a verified book-quantity baseline. Validate nonnegative actual/book quantities, live enabled warehouse and product, duplicate product lines and existing unit/cost semantics before mutation. At approval lock document and affected stock in deterministic order and reject a stale book quantity against authoritative current stock rather than silently posting a fabricated difference; require explicit re-count/edit in Pending state.

Post all adjustment lines, ledger and status in one atomic transaction. Serialize approve/approve, approval/cancel and unaudit against the same document lock. Reversal failure or later invalid line rolls back entire operation. Preserve historical movement evidence and existing permission mapping; no automatic correction of persisted historical records.
